verify.name: dir-tests
cmd: F=$( { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM origin/fix/sec-audit-1014 -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; } | sort -u); [ -z "$F" ] && exit 0; D=$(for f in $F; do d=$(dirname "$f"); echo "${d%/__tests__}"; done | sort -u); npx jest --ci --passWithNoTests $D --testPathIgnorePatterns="ellisAttack\.getCustomPricing|shopifyGraphQlService\.|redis\.service|removeRecipeMetafields"

verify.name: eslint
cmd: F=$( { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM origin/fix/sec-audit-1014 -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "*.js" "*.jsx"; } | sort -u); [ -z "$F" ] || DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1 npx eslint --rule 'no-undef: error' $F
